name: Hart-to-Hart Farm Day Camp
operator_name: Hart to Hart Farm and Educational Center
description_short: Farm day camp on a family run organic dairy farm in Albion, Maine. Each week campers care for an adopted animal, do barn chores and farm projects, and follow a theme such as cooking with farm food, 1800s pioneer life or crafts, with a week just for 5 and 6 year olds.
refund_policy_summary: Written notice two weeks before the session gets a full refund minus the $50 deposit; no refunds for missed days.

sessions.name: Down on the Farm I (ages 7 to 12)
Down on the Farm II (ages 7 to 12)
Down on the Farm III (ages 5 and 6 only)
Farm Camp Junior Chef I (ages 7 to 12)
Down on the Farm IV (ages 7 to 12)
Farm Camp Junior Chef II (ages 7 to 12)
